title: PMFBY Revision: 21-Day Claim Settlement & 12% Interest Penalty

items: **Mandatory Settlement Timeline:** Ministry of Agriculture amended Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) guidelines, requiring insurance companies and state governments to disburse settled agricultural crop claims within **21 days**.
**Statutory Interest Penalty:** Failure to settle claims within the 21-day window attracts a mandatory penal interest rate of **12% per annum** payable directly into the farmer’s bank account.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → PMFBY claim settlement window is 21 days; penal interest for delay is 12% per annum.
